requirement: Acquisition, cataloguing, serials, circulation, OPAC, barcode/spine labels, reports
notes: Reference-level ILMS functions: item creation, spreadsheet import, acquisition (purchase orders, receiving), serials (subscriptions, late issues), circulation, OPAC (public search), barcode and spine labels, reports; an add-on, not a replacement ILMS (A-02); see docs/use-cases.md; records can be corrected and copies marked damaged, lost or withdrawn with the importer's validation, audited, never deleted (DR-19)

requirement: Web UI, full-text search, real-time indexing, net cataloguing, virtual bookshelf
notes: Web interface, full-text search (SQLite FTS5, ranked), real-time indexing by triggers, net cataloguing by ISBN (mock source), virtual bookshelf, public catalogue; see docs/architecture.md; the public catalogue changes no session when opened; staff hand a screen over with the menu's sign-out button; public terminals use kiosk host names (DR-17)

requirement: Staff station, handheld, gate, smart card, tags via middleware; NCIP 2.0; SIP2 boundary
notes: Device-neutral interfaces and mocks for staff reader, handheld, gate, camera, card printer; the ILMS connector boundary with retries; SIP2 (3M 2.00) wire protocol implemented and tested against a simulator only (not certified or tested against any vendor ILMS); NCIP 2.0 not built: the project owner decided SIP2 meets the 'NCIP 2.0 / SIP2' protocol requirement (DR-13, C-10) and nothing claims NCIP; see docs/sip2.md and docs/architecture.md; the mock answers in SIP2 wording only and a configuration asking for NCIP stops at start (D-059)

requirement: Check-out/in, renew, due date, card personalisation, reference restriction, member blocking, fine limits, role-based rights
notes: RBAC, check-out/in/renew, due date, reference and blocked and fine-limit rules, fines ledger, members, patron card issue, replace and personalisation (card printer mock); Patrons page: every member, remove, restore and erase (DR-20); see docs/circulation.md

requirement: Validate title/member before tagging; tag-record association; tag monitoring
notes: Validate item and member records before tagging or card linking, both by one check per side (validate_tagging and validate_member_tagging, used by the desk, the Administration page and dry-run endpoints); associate, re-tag, remove, retire; tag monitoring; see docs/rfid.md

requirement: Stock verification, shelf mgmt, missing/misplaced, bulk read, audible/visible confirmation
notes: Shelf sessions, bulk handheld sweeps, found/missing/misplaced/unknown, audible and visible signals, shelf management (capacity) and the call-number order check, CSV; see docs/inventory.md
